description: This file defines the SavePayGradeController class, which handles the pre-render logic for the pay-grade add/edit Vue component in the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It manages the component's setup based on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request, indicating an edit or add operation.

classes.name: SavePayGradeController
classes.description: Controller class for handling the save operation of pay grades, managing the component rendering logic based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, setting up either an 'add' or 'edit' component depending on presence of 'id' in request attributes.
